Here is the current SQL (everything is functioning apart from Pascal Case handling): CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(`First Name`), ' ', -1))) = 1 AND LENGTH(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(`First Name`), ' ', 1))) > 1 THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(`First Name`), ' ', 1)) ELSE CASE -- Adjustment for double-barrelled (hyphenated) names WHEN INSTR(TRIM(`First Name`), '-') > 0 THEN CONCAT( INITCAP(LOWER(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(`First Name`), '-', 1)))), '-', INITCAP(LOWER(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(`First Name`), '-', -1)))) ) -- Adjustment for names with apostrophes WHEN INSTR(TRIM(`First Name`), "'") > 0 THEN CONCAT( INITCAP(LOWER(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(`First Name`), "'", 1)))), "'", INITCAP(LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(`First Name`), "'", -1))) ) -- Adjustment for names with mixed case WHEN TRIM(`First Name`) != INITCAP(TRIM(LOWER(`First Name`))) THEN CONCAT( UPPER(SUBSTRING(TRIM(`First Name`), 1, 1)), LOWER( CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(`First Name`)) > 1 THEN SUBSTRING(TRIM(`First Name`), 2, LENGTH(TRIM(`First Name`)) - 1) ELSE '' END ) ) ELSE INITCAP(TRIM(`First Name`)) END END AS adjusted_first_name,
